originalTitle: The pencil case model of creativity
content: Our columnist Isabella Saccardi caught herself envying a friend's creative job. But isn't academic research creative as well? "Somewhere along the way, I stopped recognising the creativity in what I was doing," she writes.
chineseContent: 我们的专栏作家伊莎贝拉·萨卡迪发现自己很羡慕朋友的创意工作。但学术研究不也具有创造性吗？ “一路走来，我不再认识到我所做的事情的创造力，”她写道。
